input.question: Who is the artist of the main song in the "Footloose" soundtrack?

documents.text: Footloose ( 2011 soundtrack ) - Wikipedia Home Random Nearby Log in Settings Donate About Wikipedia Disclaimers Search Footloose ( 2011 soundtrack ) Article Talk Language Watch Edit Footloose : Music from the Motion Picture , the original soundtrack for the 2011 remake of Footloose , was released by Atlantic Records and Warner Music Nashville on September 27 , 2011 . It includes eight new songs and four remakes of songs from the original film 's soundtrack . [ 1 ] `` Footloose `` by Kenny Loggins was covered by Blake Shelton in a country style for the remake .
